We're dealing with some truly serious people right here.




SCOTUS Wire (@scotus_wire)

🚨 Virginia Democrats indicate that they will appeal today's ruling invalidating the redistricting referendum to the United States Supreme Court.

They ask the Virginia Supreme Court to withhold its mandate.







— https://nitter.net/scotus_wire/status/2052853202513494303#m

Lmfao Virginia Democrats want the VA Supreme Court to stay their ruling while they appeal their case to the Supreme Court... which doesn't have jurisdiction because it was a state constitutional question ruled on by a state Supreme Court.


Brandon Jarvis (@Jaaavis)

Virginia Democrats have filed a motion with the Virginia Supreme Court asking for a stay in its ruling against the redisitricting amendment







— https://nitter.net/Jaaavis/status/2052850404535222721#m

Tyler Englander (@TylerEnglander)

Michelle Jump came from Henrico to protest the Supreme Court of Virginia’s ruling. 

She is shouting “shame” and says the Supreme Court silenced the people. 

Hear more from Jump tonight on @8NEWS.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/TylerEnglander/status/2052789870980894830#m

After losing in his two previous races for Congress, Democrat insiders drew the lobster district specifically for Dan Helmer so that he could finally win an election.

And he yet again takes an L.


Dan Helmer (@HelmerVA)

Voters should decide elections - not partisan judges.

I’ve spent my life fighting for this country and our democracy, and I’m never going to stop.





— https://nitter.net/HelmerVA/status/2052775811988562163#m

Hakeem Jeffries just wasted $40 million dollars on the failed Virginia referendum.

The DNC is still $18 million in debt.

Every Republican House and Senate campaign arm has raised more than their Democrat counterparts.

And the party still has a worse approval rating than herpes.

Democrats will tell us that the right is responsible for political violence in America and then go back to campaigning and doing podcasts with this psycho Turkish anchor baby who actively calls for political violence on a daily basis.


hasanabi (@hasanthehun)

the va supreme court denied the results of the redistricting referendum. scotus gutted the voting rights act and tennessee carved up the last dem district destroying black voter power in the state.

those who make peaceful revolution impo

He was also appointed to the Court of Appeals by Mark Warner and was confirmed to the Supreme Court by a unanimous vote in the General Assembly— just like the rest of the justices on the court.


Drew Savicki (@DrewSav)

One of the VA Supreme Court Justices who authored the majority is up for reappointment in January. He was appointed to the court when Republicans had control of both chambers.



— https://nitter.net/DrewSav/status/2052757543135367632#m

Unlike a lot of states, Virginia Supreme Court justices are appointed and confirmed by the General Assembly.

Nearly all of them unanimously on a bipartisan basis.

They're about as straight down the middle as you can possibly get.


Matthew Yglesias (@mattyglesias)

Don't know what the mechanisms are but these Virginia judges need to go.



— https://nitter.net/mattyglesias/status/2052762602653061242#m
